Run the three commands in order (they’re already sequenced correctly), then share the generated reports / stdout so we can decide whether to promote a new champion or open a fix PR.

## 1) AUB autopilot (module-level selection)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**Purpose:** runs the module candidates in `module_registry.yaml`, computes tuning/lockbox metrics, and (with `--select-best`) should pick the best-performing candidate relative to the current champion.

**What to capture afterward:**
- Which candidate (if any) was selected as best
- The resulting tuning_mean/min and lockbox_mean/min
- Any “regression” or “insufficient improvement” messages

## 2) System autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Purpose:** evaluates full-system candidates defined in `system_candidates.yaml` (end-to-end), typically to confirm module gains translate at system level.

**What to capture afterward:**
- The best system candidate (if any)
- Comparison vs current champion
- Any failures/timeouts

## 3) Generate next-fix guidance
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Purpose:** writes an actionable “what to fix next” report, especially useful if nothing beats the champion.

**What to share afterward:**
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` contents (or paste key sections)

## Quick sanity checks before running
- Confirm `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` exists and is the one you intend to compare against.
- Ensure the run outputs are being saved (some setups write to `baseline/reports/` or a run directory); if not, run with whatever “--output/--logdir” options your tools support.

If you paste the stdout from (1) and (2) plus the contents of `next_fix.md`, I’ll tell you whether to promote a new champion, mark anything INCONCLUSIVE, or what the highest-leverage next fix is.
